channel.title: GiveOwl – Holiday & travel competitions 2026 (NZ)
channel.description: New Zealand competitions where you can win a holiday, flights, a hotel stay or an experience. Each is checked on the organiser's own page. Free to enter unless marked.

item.title: Intrepid Travel New Trips competition: win a spot on a 2027 trip (AUD $11,000 each) – Intrepid Travel
item.description: Prize: Three prizes: a place on a new 2027 Intrepid trip (Sri Lanka, Thailand, Tasmania, Caucasus, Egypt or Barcelona to Berlin), return economy flights up to AUD $2,500, an Insta360 X5 camera and AUD $1,000 stipend, each worth AUD $11,000. Deadline: October 31, 2026. Global skill-based contest, not a random draw: submit an application on the Intrepid competition page telling them why you are the best pick for your chosen new 2027 trip. A panel judges the strength of the applications. Free, open to entrants worldwide aged 18+ (the terms say Global participants, so New Zealand residents can enter), unless entering is against the law where you live. 14 Oct to 31 Oct 2026 (11:59pm AEDT)

item.title: Hallensteins: win a trip to Samoa for 2 (worth about NZ$5,000) – Hallensteins
item.description: Prize: Return economy flights for two from Australia or New Zealand to Apia plus five nights in a Deluxe Villa at Saletoga Sands Resort & Spa, Samoa, with daily breakfast, total value about NZ$5,000. Deadline: November 1, 2026. Sign up to the Hallensteins email list through the competition entry (entry condition: you must sign up to the Hallensteins email database; people already on the list are entered automatically). Free, New Zealand and Australian residents aged 21+. 13 Oct to 1 Nov 2026 (11:59pm NZT), draw 2 Nov. Flights must be booked through Hallensteins and blackout dates apply

item.title: White & Co. x Mitchelton: win a luxury getaway for four – White & Co.
item.description: Prize: Two nights for four at Mitchelton (Nagambie, Victoria) with spa treatments, dining and a Webjet voucher, AUD $500 car hire payment and four AUD $250 White & Co. gift cards, total value AUD $5,870. Deadline: November 5, 2026. Complete the entry form on the White & Co. competition page. Entry condition: you must give express consent to White & Co. marketing by email and SMS (withdrawing it later does not invalidate the entry). Free, one entry per person, legal residents of Australia and New Zealand aged 18+. 9 Oct to 5 Nov 2026 (11:59pm AEDT), draw 9 Nov. The prize is valued in AUD and the getaway is at Mitchelton in Victoria, Australia; it includes alcohol (18+)

item.title: Win a Wellington getaway: Jesus Christ Superstar tickets + night at Sojourn Ghuznee – Sojourn Hotels
item.description: Prize: Two tickets to Jesus Christ Superstar at St James Theatre, Wellington (28 Nov 2026) plus one night for two at Sojourn Ghuznee. Deadline: November 7, 2026. Complete the entry form on the Sojourn Hotels page. Free, one entry per person, no purchase necessary, open to NZ residents 18+. Opens 19 Oct, closes 11:59pm 7 Nov 2026

item.title: MiNDFOOD: win two tickets to FEAST at Sea in Auckland – MiNDFOOD
item.description: Prize: Two tickets to FEAST at Sea with Kārena and Kasey Bird, a sunset harbour sailing from Auckland's Viaduct during Auckland FEAST (12–22 Nov 2026), worth NZ$310. Deadline: November 8, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the MiNDFOOD competition page (details plus an answer of max 25 words to the question «Where do you get your travel inspiration from?»). Free, no purchase necessary, open to New Zealand residents only; the newsletter tick-boxes are optional. 9 Oct to 8 Nov 2026 (10pm AEST), winners judged by 9 Nov

item.title: Bella Boheme: win 1 of 2 Ultimate Girls Getaways (worth AUD $5,000 each) – Bella Boheme
item.description: Prize: Two prize packages for two, each worth AUD $5,000: AUD $1,000 Bella Boheme voucher per person, two nights at Ardour Lilianfels (Blue Mountains) or Elysium Manly, spa treatment, dinner and return economy flights from Australia or New Zealand to Sydney. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the Bella Boheme giveaway page. Free, no purchase necessary, open to Australian and New Zealand residents aged 18+. 19 Oct to 15 Nov 2026 (11:59pm AEDT), draw 16 Nov

item.title: Experience Gold Coast «Get Up and Gold Coast»: win a $5,008 Gold Coast holiday – Experience Gold Coast
item.description: Prize: Gold Coast holiday package worth AUD $5,008: Webjet voucher, JW Marriott Gold Coast accommodation voucher, Experience Oz voucher, Langham Chuan Spa voucher, hot air balloon voucher and dining vouchers. Deadline: November 15, 2026. Complete the entry form on the Experience Gold Coast promotion page (name, email, mobile, date of birth, postcode) and opt in to marketing emails. Free, one entry per person, residents of NSW, VIC, SA and New Zealand aged 18+. 15 Oct to 15 Nov 2026 (11:59pm AEDT)

item.title: Muscle Republic $24K Ultimate Adventure Holiday Giveaway – Muscle Republic
item.description: Prize: One AUD $20,000 Arrival voucher, two AUD $2,000 Qantas flight vouchers and 15 AUD $500 Arrival vouchers (total AUD $31,500). Deadline: November 18, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the Muscle Republic giveaway page (name, phone, email) and opt in to email and SMS. Free, one entry per person, Australian or New Zealand residents aged 18+. 18 Sep to 18 Nov 2026 (3pm AEST), draw 19 Nov

item.title: Viking "Your Choice 2026": win a $20,000 future cruise voucher – Viking River Cruises
item.description: Prize: A $20,000 future cruise voucher for any Viking river, ocean or expedition voyage departing in 2027 or 2028. Deadline: November 30, 2026. Fill in the entry form on the Viking page (name, email, country). No purchase necessary, residents of Australia or New Zealand aged 18+, one entry per email. Starts 5 Aug 2026; the Conditions of Entry (clause 4) and the headline say the promotion ends 11.59pm AEDT on 30 Nov 2026 (a sidebar on the same page says 22 Nov, so enter early). Draw 7 Dec 2026

item.title: Air New Zealand Dream Seats: win return flights from New Zealand – Air New Zealand
item.description: Prize: At least 100 return seats from New Zealand (economy on domestic/short-haul or premium economy on long-haul). Deadline: December 20, 2026. Fill in the online Dream Seats form (dreamseats.co.nz) describing your dream trip; photo or video optional. Free, one entry per person, NZ residents (under 18 must travel with a parent). Judged, not a random draw; may close early once 100 seats are awarded
